title: Farm Real Estate Relationship Relief on Operating Lines of Credit Overadvance Fees
content:
A member who also borrows on farmland from the association pays a reduced overadvance fee on the Operating Lines of Credit. The reduction turns on the member's Farm Real Estate Loans and on whether their installments are collected by automatic payment.

## Rule

The overadvance fee is reduced:

- **by the share 0.25** when the member holds a Farm Real Estate loan in active status whose installments are collected by automatic payment;
- **by the share 0.1** when the member holds a Farm Real Estate loan in active status whose installments are not collected by automatic payment;
- **by nothing** when the member holds no Farm Real Estate loan in active status.

Reducing the fee by a share means multiplying the fee figured from the overadvance portion and its percentage by one less that share, before the fee is rounded to cents. The loan's status and its automatic payment enrolment are read from the member's Farm Real Estate Loans records.

## Judgement table

| Farm Real Estate loan in active status | Installments on automatic payment | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| Held | Yes | 0.75 of the fee figured |
| Held | No | 0.9 of the fee figured |
| None held (none at all, or only loans no longer active) | — | The whole fee figured |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

An overadvance fee figured at USD 1,000.00 before this reduction is charged at USD 750.00 to a member whose active FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage is on automatic payment, at USD 900.00 if that mortgage is not on automatic payment, and at USD 1,000.00 to a member whose only farmland mortgage has been paid off.
